name: Plate XX: The Enneagram
description: Gurdjieff's symbol of perpetual motion: the Law of Three in the triangle, the Law of Seven in the circulating figure 1-4-2-8-5-7. Struck in Nigredo: the blackening, where every matter is first dissolved. Degree of Adept, rank 76 of the folio. “ORA LEGE LEGE LEGE RELEGE LABORA ET INVENIES”: Pray, read, read, read, reread, work, and you will find (Mutus Liber).
